review.method: Rule-text and fixture-data cross-check, not candidate-output-derived expectations
review.limitations: Official fixtures only; no real-study approval, P21 equivalence, or exhaustive boundary coverage. All positive/01 cases expect zero findings.

rules.basis: INCLUSION rows 1-3 have Y/Yes/Nope instead of literal N. Positive inclusion rows are N; the exclusion row is outside the precondition.
Only row 7 has ECOCCUR=N with nonpositive numeric ECDOSE=0. N with 20 or null does not violate the written comparison; positive rows use Y/5 or N/null.
N/U/N are nonempty and not Y. Blank is excluded; positive values are Y or blank.
Row 5 has ETCD=UNPLAN with a nonempty ELEMENT. Positive UNPLAN has an empty ELEMENT; other ETCD values are outside the precondition.
Negative UNPLAN row 5 has nonempty TAETORD. Positive UNPLAN has null TAETORD; ELEMENT is not this rule's target.
Row 3 has DSTERM=COMPLETED but DSDECOD=ADVERSE EVENT. Positive uses COMPLETED for both; other DSTERM values are outside the precondition.

DEATH rows joined to DM by USUBJID differ at row 7 (2022-02-20 versus 2021-02-18), 21 (2019-01-10 versus blank), 26 (2021-01-10 versus 2021-01). The operator is literal inequality, not partial-date ordering. Positive joined strings agree, including blank/blank.
Planned SCREENING 1/2 visits do not belong to negative TV's SCREEN 1/2 list. Positive TV uses SCREENING 1/2. Unplanned visits are excluded by SVPRESP=Y.
TT is listed in negative dataset metadata and absent in positive. Record 1 locates a dataset-presence finding, not every TT data record.
TP is listed in negative dataset metadata and absent in positive. Record 1 locates a dataset-presence finding.
Rows 1 and 11 have both ARMCD and ARMNRS empty. Row 15 has SCREEN FAILURE as the reason and is valid. Positive fills ARMCD on rows 1 and 11.
Both negative DV dates (2011-01-02, 2012-11-22) precede joined DM consent 2012-11-23. Positive dates are equal or later. These fixtures do not test partial-date boundaries.
